requirements.evidence: Pinned PokéAPI version 31/32 rows supply overworld, Sea Skim water, rare-spawn and post-champion sky methods; generation asserts every PKHeX GP/GE wild location and species is present. Partner, Kanto starter (catch-count 30/50/60), Magikarp salesman, Fighting Dojo choice, Silph Co., fossil and all ten Alolan trade rows are asserted against PKHeX Encounters7GG species, form, level, location and version, and PKHeX-commented Power Plant Electrode statics are dropped. Water rows follow Sea Skim (chapter 5), Snorlax the Poké Flute, sky rows are post-champion and rare spawns stay conditional; catch combos and lures only change odds and are not used for timing.

Partner Pikachu/Eevee rows use the pikachu-starter/eevee-starter form profiles (boosted stats, own learnsets) and are excluded from every evolution path; the ten Alolan trade forms keep their form indexes, types and stats through the form profiles.

Version-group 19 per-form level and TM rows are used. Level moves follow chapter level bands and the join-level moveset; the Indigo Plateau move reminder (Heart Scale, chapter 8) restores earlier level moves; reusable TMs use the same inferred timing rule as Generations 1-7; partner tutor moves are never recommended.

PKHeX evos_gg confirms Kanto forms only evolve into Kanto forms (no Alolan regional evolutions), traded Alolan forms evolve into their Alolan forms without time-of-day conditions, and Alolan Meowth evolves at level 28. Moon Stone is placed at Mt. Moon (chapter 2) and Fire, Thunder, Water, Leaf and Ice Stones at the Celadon Department Store 4F (chapter 4). Partners never evolve and trade evolutions follow the no-trade preference.

Eight gyms, the Silph Co. Giovanni battle (Lv.39), Viridian Gym Giovanni, the Elite Four (Lorelei 51-52, Bruno 52-53, Agatha 53-54, Lance 54-55) and the rival champion battle are ordered by chapter with cross-checked levels; rival and Team Rocket mid-story battles are not separate planner bosses, matching Generations 1-7.

Chop Down and Light Up (chapter 3), Sky Dash (chapter 4), Strong Push and Sea Skim (chapter 5) are partner Secret Techniques with no party HM slots; Sea Skim gates water spawns and the Poké Flute gates the Route 12/16 Snorlax.
Let's Go Pikachu/Eevee GameConfigs use the letsgo7 family for six-member, four-move planning, roadmaps and pokemon-roadmap:v3 save restoration.
Separate Sword and Shield hidden, symbol and base-den resources preserve species, form, location, weather, method, level, raid stars and badge gates.

Pinned PKHeX Isle of Armor and Crown Tundra wild, symbol, permanent den, static, gift, fossil and in-game trade rows are normalized with update 1.2.0/1.3.0, DLC access, catch-cap, water-bike and weather conditions. Wedgehurst Slowpoke is separately pinned to the free 1.1.0 preview. Temporal distribution dens are excluded from permanent availability. Max Lair rows preserve form, rental-team access, one-catch legendary scope and opposite-version host requirements.

Form-indexed encounters and learnsets resolve through the pinned PokéAPI form profile to Korean name, type and stats. Battle-only profiles remain explicitly marked; Gigantamax eligibility and the Rusted Sword/Shield, Max Soup, Urshifu and Reins of Unity choice/form-change rules are preserved separately from persistent party identity.

Pinned game-specific legality distinguishes level, egg, reusable TM, consumable TR and tutor moves per form. The authored acquisition table maps all 100 TMs to locations/chapters, all 100 TRs to exact Watt cost and daily rotation, base tutors to story chapters, and 18 Armorite tutors to the first dojo trial and five-Ore repeat cost. Probabilistic raid rewards are disclosed but never used to advance deterministic move timing; duplicate TR/tutor copies produce resource-conflict warnings.

Game-specific evolution selection preserves level, friendship/time, held item, trade, known move, gender/stat, spin, three-critical-hit, 49-damage arch and regional-form rules. Authored item and location milestones cover all base and DLC evolution items, including one-of apple/tower/steed paths and the daily rotating Chipped Pot source.
The preview fixes all eight version-aware gyms, Champion Cup, Rose Tower, Eternatus and Leon in chronological chapters.

Machine-enforced chapters split Isle entry, three trials, single Tower choice, Max Honey epilogue, Crown entry, Max Lair, Calyrex/steed choice, legendary clues and Galarian Star Tournament. Boss rows carry version branches, one-of groups, level scaling and win-required semantics.
The base preview and encounter snapshot preserve bike upgrades, weather, badge-count raid gates and no party HM requirement.

Sword and Shield run through canonical six-member generation, form-aware four-move legality and Korean roadmaps. Reusable TM versus consumable TR/Ore conflicts are explicit, DLC chapters retain stable IDs, unsupported games still fail closed, and pokemon-roadmap:v3 persistence remains unchanged.
Separate BD and SP overworld resources preserve species, form, location and level, and the pinned static table identifies gifts and version mascots.

Pinned BD/SP overworld and Grand Underground resources preserve exact species, form, location and level rows. Independently authored, cross-checked gates attach Explorer Kit, badge, Defog, Strength, Icicle Badge, Waterfall, National Dex, daily swarm, Poké Radar, Great Marsh binocular and Trophy Garden activation conditions.
Pinned encounter form indices and PokéAPI form profiles provide form-aware Korean identity, types and stats; battle-only forms are excluded from persistent party choices.

Version-group 23 level, shared egg, 100 consumable TM and tutor legality is joined to exact first acquisition chapters, five-copy Gym rewards, one-copy limits, repeatable Department Store/Battle Park sources, all 67 rotating Underground TM rows with badge gates, Pastoria Heart Scale reminder timing and compatible-parent evidence.

BDSP evolution methods preserve level, item, held-item trade, friendship, gender, move, time and special-location rules and map version-exclusive evolution items and postgame trade items to earliest chapters.

Pinned walkthrough revision 4577633 is normalized into ordered badge chapters with all mandatory rival, Gym, Galactic commander, partner double, Spear Pillar, Elite Four and Cynthia battles, plus National Dex and Stark Mountain postgame chapters.
Rock Smash, Cut, Fly, Defog, Surf, Strength, Rock Climb and Waterfall are represented as Pokétch app unlocks and never consume party move slots.

Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl run through the canonical Korean six-member/four-move planner with form-aware legality, consumable TM copy enforcement, stable chapter IDs, unsupported fallbacks and unchanged pokemon-roadmap:v3 persistence.

PKHeX LA standard and landmark (shaking tree/ore) slots are keyed by parent field area with alpha slots kept as a condition; tables limited to Ramanas Island, Holm of Trials or other water-only spots wait for the Basculegion ride, and wild Pokémon are recommended only from the chapter whose Survey Corps rank makes them obey (2 stars Lv.30 through 5 stars Lv.60, the ranks needed to reach each next field). Space-time distortions, mass outbreaks, requests, research tasks and non-starter statics are random or unverified and are excluded from recommendations; starters are asserted against PKHeX StaticLA.

PKHeX LA form indexes map to PokéAPI form profiles so Hisuian forms, white-striped Basculin and other forms carry their own types, stats and learnsets; alpha is a capture condition, not a separate form.

Version-group 24 per-form level-up rows are used and any learned level move can be swapped from the menu at no cost; Zisu move-shop tutoring is not recommended because its unlock timing is unverified, and mastery or Agile/Strong styles change move execution rather than move availability.

PKHeX evos_la confirms trade evolutions use the Linking Cord, held-item evolutions use the item (with day/night where required) and magnetic, mossy and icy evolutions have stone alternatives, so no trade is required. Because Linking Cords, evolution items and stones come from Merit Points, requests or random drops, every item evolution is placed at the last main chapter as inferred timing; Agile/Strong style, recoil-damage and full-moon Peat Block evolutions are also inferred.

The five noble frenzies, the three lakes and red chain, Kamado and the Temple of Sinnoh finale are ordered as seven chapters with noble levels; clan and rival skirmishes are not separate planner bosses, matching the other families.
The preview uses survey-area chapters and Wyrdeer, Ursaluna, Basculegion, Sneasler and Braviary ride unlocks; no gyms or classic HM slots are synthesized.
The Legends: Arceus GameConfig uses the hisui8 family for six-member, four-move planning, roadmaps and pokemon-roadmap:v3 save restoration.
